title: Arc and Mutex
summary: Share mutable data safely across multiple threads using atomic reference counting and mutual exclusion.
lecture: Sharing data across threads requires both multi-ownership and synchronization.
Arc provides atomic reference counting so multiple threads can own the same allocation. Mutex provides interior mutability and ensures only one thread can access the underlying data at a time.
Together, Arc<Mutex<T>> is the standard pattern for shared, mutable state in multi-threaded Rust.

example.caption: Clone the Arc to share ownership, lock the Mutex to mutate.
